name: Mountain Mover's client tooltip shows percentage units for its stacked buff (#5040)
contract: Mountain Mover 805643 promises that each 805644 stack reduces Wildclaw's Rage cost by ten percent and increases its damage by five percent. The helper uses ADD_PCT_MODIFIER effects, resolving to -10 and +5 per stack. Its original aura tooltip, 'Your next Wildclaw costs ${$w1} less Rage and deals ${$w3} more damage.', omits both percentage units. Publish the same stack-aware expressions with percent signs through coa_client_spell_description's ToolTip override. The client's spell row must carry the corrected text, while live one-stack and three-stack cost/damage modifiers preserve the authored percentages. The existing primalist-mountain-mover scenario covers avoided-attack acquisition and stack consumption. This verifies the client's spell data and modifiers; rendered client text is outside the harness.

steps.label: CONTROL: the client's Runeshroud row 500639 is read
One stack reduces cost by ten percent
One stack increases damage by five percent
Three stacks reduce cost by thirty percent
Three stacks increase damage by fifteen percent
The client has the buff tooltip row
The tooltip retains the stack-aware Rage expression and its percentage unit
The tooltip retains the stack-aware damage expression and its percentage unit
